actual_Boolean_family: F(x,y)=(-1)^q(y) (-1)^(x*(normal dot y + coset)); and single full-cell quadratic phases. Genuine Boolean partition rows.
parameter_domain: mY=3, all 128 degree<=2 polynomials (constant,3 linear,3 quadratic coefficients), all 7 nonzero hyperplane normals and 2 coset choices; plus all128 full-cell rows.
symmetry: none; global signs and complementary labels both kept
arithmetic: integer Walsh, Fraction; GF(2) rank; exact prime-log entropy, no floating inequalities
